key.name: switch-left
key.summary: Focus the previous window (back through recently-used order)

key.name: switch-right
key.summary: Focus the next window (forward through recently-used order)

key.name: switcher-panel
key.description: Show an on-screen list of the windows being switched through, with the focused one highlighted, while stepping with the switch shortcuts.

key.name: switcher-panel-timeout
key.summary: How long the switcher panel stays visible after the last press, in milliseconds

key.name: excluded-app-ids
key.summary: GTK application IDs to treat as system chrome
key.description: Windows whose GTK application ID matches one of these are treated as system chrome (like a panel or dock) and never get a focus ring.

key.name: excluded-title-keywords
key.summary: Window title substrings to treat as system chrome
key.description: Windows whose title contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive) are treated as system chrome and never get a focus ring.
